messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — aiming to pin nova-2.1 to the model catalog tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need owners for smoke, metadata, and rollback readiness.
Liam: I can own smoke at 10:00. What are the exact smoke steps?
Maria: Short list: health endpoint, 10 representative prompt checks, embeddings sanity, latency tail check (512 tokens), and a 1% canary routing for 15m.
Dina: I will validate model metadata and license. Plan to run ingest/tests at 09:30 UTC.
Ben: I'll prepare the rollback tag + traffic-shift playbook. Also will wire a temporary alert: error-rate > 0.5% during canary. :eyes: 
Oliver: PR for the catalog pin is merged (linked in #eng-ml-cr). I left a config comment about per-route timeouts.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy pinned-models/nova-2.1 -> catalog at 10:00 UTC by Maria
Maria: Role call: smoke -> Liam; metadata & license -> Dina; rollback & monitoring -> Ben; deploy owner & oncall -> Oliver. Ping here if any conflicts.
Liam: ack. I'll paste a compact smoke checklist shortly.
Liam: ```
- GET /v1/health -> 200
- sample prompt: "Summarize invoice 2024-08-01" -> sanity check output
- embeddings compare vs baseline (cosine > 0.88)
- tail latency check for 512 tokens < 120ms p95
- KV cache warm-up check
- verify canary routing 1%
```
Dina: ran local ingest, manifests look good. One note: model_card missing quantization note — adding now.
Ben: Rollback plan: tag nova-2.0 as fallback, shift routing to previous variant, unpin. Runbook draft in the deploy doc.
Oliver: Confirmed per-route timeout and quant profile set. Minor config tweak committed.
Maria: If no blockers by 09:50 UTC I'll flip the deploy. Please react with :thumbsup: when ready.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Dina: :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Oliver: :thumbsup:
Maria: starting canary now (10:00 UTC)
deploy-bot: canary started at 10:00 UTC — 1% traffic directed to nova-2.1
Liam: smoke checks running — health OK, first 10 prompts look good.
Dina: metadata updated in registry; license note added.
Ben: monitoring looks stable, no error-rate spike. Rollback playbook on standby.
Oliver: saw a brief latency blip at 10:03 but it settled; leaving note in observability dashboard.
Maria: no major issues, proceeding to ramp after 10:15 per plan.
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete at 10:17 UTC
Maria: thanks team — documented checklist and owners in /docs/catalog/onboarding/nova-2.1. Closing thread.
